constants.EFFECT_FIELD: The kind of change this action makes, declared truthfully: the kinds are under Effects in your instructions.
constants.EFFECT_HELP: The kind of change this action makes, declared truthfully. send: it delivers the owner's message, post or email to people or a public audience (a sign-in, search, filter or settings change is edit or navigate); pay: the final Pay or confirm control of a payment, or an action FERB says can pay, with the amount you expect to pay in destination; destroy: a permanent delete; account_security: changing a password, two-factor or recovery settings, or deleting the account; signing in with existing credentials is edit. FERB checks a declared send, payment, delete or account-security change like one and asks the owner when it must; a declaration never grants permission.
constants.DESTINATION_FIELD: With effect send, pay, destroy or account_security: what the action reaches, as the page or app shows it (the fields are under Effects in your instructions).
constants.DESTINATION_HELP: with effect send, pay, destroy or account_security, what the action reaches, as the page or app shows it (never only in why). recipients: the people a message or email goes to (none for a public post); account: the account it posts, sends or pays from, or whose security it changes; amount: what a payment pays, and currency: its currency as the page shows it (₹, $, INR); item: what a delete removes. FERB checks these against the owner's words and any standing permission; they never grant permission.

tools.name: wait.for
tools.description: Wait in code, with no AI calls, until any one of your conditions holds or the time limit passes; you get one result saying which condition woke you and what FERB saw (matching output lines, a file's size, the page lines that matched, a script's output). Use it instead of calling shell.wait, a page read or a sleep again and again. Conditions (any_of, any one wakes you): process {id, match?: wake when it exits or its output holds match}; file {path, state: exists | gone | settled (exists and stopped changing for settle_s)}; page {tab, match?: wake when its text holds match, or without match when it changes; every_s >= 30; reload: load its address again before each read}; url {tab, match?: its address holds match, or changes}; mail {tab showing a mailbox, sender / subject / text: a new line naming them appears}; download {tab: it downloads a file}; time {in_minutes or at "HH:MM"}; script {command, cwd?, every_s >= 5: runs in FERB's shell sandbox as shell.run does; exit 0 wakes you}. match is plain text, case aside (regex: true for a regular expression). limit_minutes: how long at most (default 30, longer or shorter as the work needs, up to the task's own limit). A message from the owner wakes you too, and so does any of this task's commands ending; right after an action of yours failed it returns at once. While you wait, the task's status shows what you wait for.
